request.question: Select the single best primary handler for this request.

options.description: api_platform: Handles application routing after requests reach the correct endpoint.
authoritative_dns: Changes public zone records and delegation at the authoritative provider.
endpoint_devices: Handles per-device hosts files and local resolver configuration.
network_dns: Troubleshoots enterprise recursive resolvers, split-horizon/conditional zones, and resolver caches.
tls_certificates: Handles certificate issuance, hostname coverage, and TLS chains.

runtime.readout: llama-server raw top-N logprobs restricted to declared answer slots
